from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, scf, dft
import numpy as np
smi='CCC(C)C1C(C)N1C'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=2025, useRandomCoords=True)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
conf=m.GetConformer()
xyz=[]
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
    xyz.append((a.GetSymbol(),(p.x,p.y,p.z)))
for basis in ['sto-3g','6-31g*']:
    mol=gto.M(atom=xyz, basis=basis, charge=0, spin=0, unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
    mf=scf.RHF(mol).run(conv_tol=1e-10, verbose=0)
    homo=mf.mo_energy[mf.mo_occ>0][-1]
    print('RHF',basis,'HOMO_Ha',format(float(homo),'.10f'),'E_Ha',format(float(mf.e_tot),'.10f'),'converged',mf.converged)
try:

    mf=dft.RKS(mol); mf.xc='b3lyp'; mf.conv_tol=1e-9; mf.kernel()
